title: Fundamental particles and the quark model
design_rationale: Move from nucleons and beta decay to their fundamental-particle description.
concepts_taught: Recall the six quark flavours and use quark and antiquark charges.
Describe proton, neutron, baryon and meson quark compositions.
Describe quark changes in beta-minus and beta-plus decay.
Classify electrons and neutrinos as fundamental leptons.

next_module_can_assume: Recall the six quark flavours and use quark and antiquark charges.
Describe proton, neutron, baryon and meson quark compositions.
Describe quark changes in beta-minus and beta-plus decay.
Classify electrons and neutrinos as fundamental leptons.
next_module_must_not_assume: Other quark properties, force carriers and the Standard Model beyond the stated AS syllabus are outside scope.
